purpose: Bind several native front/back product proofs to distinct identities, replaceable image stages, concept facets, and cross-product narrative links without standardizing their layout.
proof_checks: The family-system manifest and all referenced build proofs are re-audited from exact bytes.
The selected proof is a two-page composition recipe with explicit front/back duplex intent; physical print review remains pending.
Identity name, backronym, descriptor and sequence match the pinned native content and appear in extracted PDF text.
Each declared media stage binds one exact raster source from the build report; captions and source-status labels match native content and extracted PDF text.
Contain placement preserves image aspect ratio inside an inset panel; declared image panels and captions remain in page bounds and do not overlap each other.
Concept facets point to authored content and current media IDs; cross-product links resolve within the suite.
limits: Panel geometry is a declared allocation, not a measurement of printed PDF pixels. The audit does not verify the visual subject of an image, factual product claims, generated-media rights, or physical print readiness; separate image and page review is required.
